body:
Follow-up to robofab-slipthresh (its next step, first half). Repeats the 16-threshold sweep at mu 0.3/0.5/0.8, with and without 5 m/s^2 lift (2,496 MuJoCo trajectories).

- Reproduces the slipthresh baseline row exactly.
- 20 mm/s is the only threshold under 5x spread in all six conditions (1.6 to 4.5); every other is at least 20x.
- Stylised, one engine; limitations in README.
- 8 tests pass; `site/build.py` prints ok (419 projects).
